question: Why did the average total amount per yellow taxi trip jump on Monday 20 Jan 2025 compared with the other Mondays in January 2025?

hmem_recall.content: Investigation recorded-example-2-snow-saturday: Q='Did the snowfall on Saturday 21 Dec 2024 reduce NYC yellow taxi trips compared with the other Saturdays in December 2024, and why?' -> answered: Saturday 21 Dec 2024 taxi trips were essentially unchanged despite heavy snowfall (supported: H0, H1, H3, H5, H6)
Lesson: avg_total_amount includes tip and surcharges; if analyzing base fare only, adjust the query to exclude those columns.

Lesson (SQL repair on whybot.yellow_daily): error 'Zetaris error: java.sql.SQLException: org.apache.hive.service.cli.HiveSQLException: com.zetaris.lightning.error.LightningException: <<<[UNRESOLVED_COLUMN.WITH_S' was fixed by: SELECT trip_date, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY trip_date ORDER BY trip_date LIMIT 50
Lesson: yellow_daily table aggregates by trip_date; ensure weekday filtering is applied correctly when comparing against a specific Saturday.

Lesson (SQL repair on whybot.us_holidays): error 'RESULT SANITY CHECK FAILED: query returned 0 rows (check filters and date formats)' was fixed by: SELECT h.holiday_date, h.holiday_name, h.is_national FROM whybot.us_holidays h WHERE h.holiday_date = DATE '2024-12-20' OR h.holiday_date = DATE '2024-12-23' ORDER BY h.holiday_date LIMIT 500

{
  "sql": "SELECT 
  trip_date,
  avg_total_amount AS avg_total_amount,
  trips AS trips,
  avg_trip_distance AS avg_trip_distance
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date IN (DATE '2025-01-06', DATE '2025-01-13', DATE '2025-01-20', DATE '2025-01-27')
ORDER BY trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Compares the target Monday 2025-01-20 against the other three Mondays in January 2025 using explicit DATE literals and IN-clause to avoid self-joins per Zetaris quirk."
}

No self-joins on the view."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT trip_date,
       trips,
       avg_trip_distance,
       CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN avg_total_amount END AS target_amount,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_amount
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY trip_date
ORDER BY trip_date",
  "tables_used": ["whybot.yellow_daily"],
  "note": "Compares avg_total_amount on 2025-01-20 (Monday) against baseline of other Mondays in January 2025 using conditional aggregation to avoid self-joining the same view."
}

{"sql":"SELECT trip_date,
       MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN trips END) AS target_trips,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips,
       MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN avg_trip_distance END) AS target_avg_distance,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_distance,
       MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_amount,
       AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date <> DATE '2025-01-20' AND dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_amount
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
GROUP BY trip_date
ORDER BY trip_date
LIMIT 500","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Conditional aggregation compares 2025-01-20 (Monday) against other Mondays in January 2025. dayofweek=2 filters to Mondays. MAX/AVG across single group per date returns one row per trip_date."}

{"sql":"SELECT trip_date,
       trips,
       avg_total_amount,
       CASE WHEN dayofweek(trip_date) = 2 THEN 'Monday' ELSE NULL END AS weekday_label
FROM whybot.yellow_daily
WHERE dayofweek(trip_date) = 2
  AND trip_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND trip_date < DATE '2025-02-01'
ORDER BY trip_date","tables_used":["whybot.yellow_daily"],"note":"Filters for Mondays (dayofweek=2) in January 2025, ordered chronologically to compare 20 Jan against 6,13,27 Jan."}

{
  "sql": "SELECT tz.zone, tz.LocationID,
  CASE WHEN tz.zone LIKE '%JFK%' THEN 'JFK'
       WHEN tz.zone LIKE '%LGA%' THEN 'LGA'
       WHEN tz.zone LIKE '%Newark%' THEN 'Newark'
       WHEN tz.borough = 'Manhattan' THEN 'Manhattan'
       ELSE 'Other'
  END AS zone_category
FROM NY_TAXI.taxi_zones tz
WHERE tz.LocationID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY zone_category, tz.zone",
  "tables_used": ["NY_TAXI.taxi_zones"],
  "note": "Lists zone and LocationID values; airport zones identified by name pattern, Manhattan zones by borough filter."
}
